overview_description.description:
Compass is a real estate technology company that provides an online platform for buying, renting, and selling real estate assets.

Its end-to-end platform supports the entire buying and selling workflow by pairing the industry’s top talent with technology to make the search and sell experience intelligent and seamless. Compass operates in 22+ regions across the United States including New York, Los Angeles, and Orange County, Chicago, San Francisco, Boston, Washington D.C., South Florida, The Hamptons, Santa Barbara and Montecito, San Diego, Seattle and Eastside, Philadelphia, Connecticut, Westchester, Aspen, Boulder, Denver, Atlanta, Austin, and Central Texas, Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, Nashville, and Lake Tahoe.

The firm was founded in 2012 by Ugo Di Girolamo, Ori Allon, and Robert Reffkin in New York, New York.

press_references.value: Everything you need to know about Zillow’s listing war with MRED and Compass

legal_proceedings.description: Compass filed and later voluntarily dismissed an antitrust lawsuit against Zillow challenging its Listing Access Standards policy; a judge had earlier denied Compass’s motion for a preliminary injunction that sought to block Zillow from enforcing the policy.

press_references.value: Zillow rebuts Compass claims of conspiracy in antitrust lawsuit

legal_proceedings.description: Compass is pursuing an antitrust lawsuit and a preliminary injunction to block Zillow from enforcing its listing access standards; Zillow’s reply disputes the claims, with a hearing set for next week.

press_references.value: Court permits Zillow to review select Compass-Anywhere communications in antitrust case

legal_proceedings.description: Compass’s antitrust suit against Zillow proceeds in U.S. District Court; the judge ordered limited discovery allowing Zillow to review certain Compass–Anywhere communications tied to the recently announced acquisition and denied a further deposition of CEO Robert Reffkin.

press_references.value: Zillow says no to Compass deposition of Lloyd Frink

legal_proceedings.description: Compass, which is suing to block enforcement of Zillow’s listing standards policy, sought to depose Lloyd Frink ahead of a November preliminary‑injunction hearing; Zillow has opposed the deposition.

press_references.value: Compass’s exclusive inventory is on the rise

legal_proceedings.description: Compass filed an antitrust lawsuit against Zillow over a listings policy it says harms its three-phase marketing plan, seeking a preliminary injunction; analysts note rising Compass exclusive inventory may affect the case narrative.

press_references.value: NWMLS says it has ‘no duty to deal’ with Compass

legal_proceedings.description: Compass filed an antitrust lawsuit against Northwest MLS (NWMLS), alleging that NWMLS's rules regarding listing sharing are anticompetitive. NWMLS has filed a motion to dismiss, arguing Compass has not shown harm to competition or antitrust injury. The case is ongoing, with a trial date set for June 8, 2026.

product.name: Compass Real Estate Marketplace

product.name: Residential Real Estate Brokerage Services

product.name: Compass Agent Platform
product.description: A technology and support platform that helps Compass agents manage real estate relationships, listings, marketing, and transactions from contact through closing.

product.description: A pre-closing home improvement financing service that covers eligible preparation costs for sellers, with repayment generally due at closing.
